Elena — thanks for the files and the clear options. Short answers up front:
- Video-notarization is acceptable as an interim verification in most cases, provided the recording includes a timestamp, the notary's credential (license number), and an explicit notary statement.
- We need either an EIN (US entities) or the foreign TIN plus the signed W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities).
- We can issue a conditional/limited PO up to $25k for initial work while final compliance checks complete; anything above that requires full verification.

Next steps:
1) If you can provide the video-notary recording, please upload it to the secure portal link I shared (I pasted a new portal link below — the portal accepts a single MP4 or A/V archive up to 250MB).
2) Complete the W-8BEN-E in DocuSign (we prefer DocuSign for the audit trail). I can send a draft envelope if you want.
3) Please confirm the corporate tax ID used on the attached registration page (format + issuing country).

Marissa / Kimberly — looping you in to confirm procurement path and PO cap.

Full bank letters are preferred but the alternatives you suggested are acceptable — please mark any shared bank docs as "confidential" when you upload.
